name: jam-privacy-wallet
description: The JAM privacy wallet page: proves in the browser with noir_js and bb.js; keys stay in the browser

scripts.build: esbuild src/provers.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/provers.js --log-level=warning && esbuild node_modules/@aztec/bb.js/dest/browser/barretenberg_wasm/barretenberg_wasm_main/factory/browser/main.worker.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/main.worker.js --log-level=warning && esbuild node_modules/@aztec/bb.js/dest/browser/barretenberg_wasm/barretenberg_wasm_thread/factory/browser/thread.worker.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/thread.worker.js --log-level=warning && cp node_modules/@noir-lang/acvm_js/web/acvm_js_bg.wasm node_modules/@noir-lang/noirc_abi/web/noirc_abi_wasm_bg.wasm dist/
